body: From the DM-181 review (orchestrator, this run): epic Scorecard wording follow-ups to fix and pin — 'as of the final report' is used for any frozen window still open at its cutoff, including an earlier run's non-final report (openNote in epicScorecardView.ts; use 'its last report' and the run's lifecycle end); '(still running, a lower bound)' appears under a 'Run #2 · completed' heading (n11); a total both estimated and a lower bound shows only '≥'; the active-clock note can name the same run twice. Pin: a completed epic's totals say '≥ … (no usage was frozen for Run #N)' rather than reading live data.
